meaningful_difference.rationale: Mapping A proposes a factorial replay (configuration x load on r1, then configuration on r2) and iterative narrowing, which is essentially the ordinary staging-replay and route-contrast practice of a reliability engineer. Mapping B adds an explicit evidence-by-hypothesis inconsistency matrix and a sensitivity pass that removes the confounded live aggregate and re-evaluates, shifting what counts as evidence and why conclusions are warranted. That is a material difference in departure from the baseline.

action.rationale: A runs old/new at low/high load on r1 then old/new low-load r2; the baseline already replays workloads under stratified configuration and load and tests competing causes, so A's actions are ordinary. B runs fewer replays (low-load r1 and r2 contrasts) but adds two non-ordinary activities: constructing a formal inconsistency matrix over all supplied records and repeating it after deliberately dropping the confounded live aggregate. B changes practitioner activity more.

observables.rationale: A treats contrasts as supporting, contradicting or non-discriminating, which is how an engineer already reads replay results. B redefines meaningful evidence as cross-hypothesis inconsistency weighted by diagnosticity, discounts support counts, and treats the live aggregate as an evidence item whose removal is itself an observable (do contradictions persist or vanish). That is a larger change in what counts as evidence.

inferential_warrant.rationale: A's warrant is narrowing by reprioritization without claiming a unique mechanism, close to ordinary bisect-and-narrow reasoning. B's warrant is elimination by important inconsistency plus robustness of the surviving set when uncertain evidence is withdrawn, an explicit sensitivity-based justification the baseline does not formalize.

problem_decomposition.rationale: A decomposes by load factor and by route composition (r1 vs r2 isolates A-confined from B-dependency effects), which is an ordinary component/route/configuration decomposition. B decomposes the problem into an evidence-items-by-hypotheses matrix with per-item diagnosticity, a different operational structure than components and routes.

inquiry_trajectory.rationale: A ends by selecting a dependency for later investigation, a standard handoff. B's next step depends on whether contradictions survive removal of the live aggregate and explicitly aims to expose a missing hypothesis or the next discriminating route, so the sensitivity result steers what is investigated next in a way the baseline does not build in.

local_depth.rationale: B's deepest departure is the sensitivity re-run of the inconsistency matrix with confounded evidence removed; A's deepest point is a factorial replay design that ordinary practice already uses.

inquiry_propagation.rationale: B's matrix representation carries through the initial analysis, the replay contrasts and the repeated matrix, shaping each subsequent judgment. A's two replay steps propagate an ordinary narrowing logic.

task_reach.rationale: B's inconsistency-and-sensitivity framing governs how all attribution evidence, including the unresolved live-workload generalization and possible missing hypotheses, would be weighed. A's altered reasoning covers only the replay contrasts and a dependency selection.

native_reducibility.rationale: A translates directly into staging replay and route contrast with no lost distinction. B's emphasis on contradictions over support and its robustness check under evidence removal are distinctions an ordinary write-up would flatten into 'we discounted the confounded live numbers'.

decisive_basis.most_important_difference: B introduces an explicit inconsistency matrix and a sensitivity pass that removes the confounded live aggregate, changing what counts as evidence and why conclusions hold; A's factorial replay and route contrast are ordinary reliability-engineering practice dressed in differential-diagnosis vocabulary.
decisive_basis.local_depth: B's sensitivity re-run is a deeper departure at its most changed point than A's replay design.
decisive_basis.inquiry_propagation: B's matrix structures both analysis passes and the follow-up; A's narrowing logic is the baseline's own.
decisive_basis.task_reach: B's evidence-weighting stance governs the whole attribution task including unresolved parts; A's reach is limited to the replay contrasts.
decisive_basis.native_reducibility: A reduces losslessly to ordinary replay; B's contradiction emphasis and robustness check lose an operational distinction when translated back.
decisive_basis.rationale: A has no countervailing displacement advantage. Its inclusion of a high-load arm may be more informative about the load-only hypothesis, but informativeness is not displacement, and stratified replay across load is a listed ordinary method. B's differences are modest in absolute terms but consistently exceed A's across every respect, so B dominates.

uncertainty: Both mappings rely on the same replay affordance and additive-delay calibration, so B's absolute displacement is moderate rather than large.
A reliability engineer might informally discount the confounded live aggregate, which would narrow B's advantage on observables and warrant.
Outcomes are not supplied; whether B's sensitivity pass would actually change the surviving set is unknown at the prospective stage.
